Messages.Body:
GP...@videotron.ca wrote:
> The question is short and simple.
>
> After a combat, which one of these two, Fast Reaction and Hidden
Lurker,
> will take have effect first?

The one played first.
The acting Methuselah always gets first opportunity to play a
card or effect.

(And note: after player one, neither card be played again, since
the combatants of that subsequent combat are not the "acting and
blocking" minions).
